tasks.label: Ensure Container
tasks.command: docker inspect --format='{{.State.Running}}' toudou-dev 2>/dev/null | grep -q true || (docker rm -f toudou-dev 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name toudou-dev -v "${workspaceFolder}":/home/node/workspace -w /home/node/workspace -u node toudou-dev tail -f /dev/null && docker exec toudou-dev npm install)

tasks.label: Compile
tasks.command: docker exec toudou-dev npm run compile

tasks.label: Watch
tasks.command: docker exec toudou-dev npm run watch

tasks.label: Lint
tasks.command: docker exec toudou-dev npm run lint

tasks.label: Type Check
tasks.command: docker exec toudou-dev npm run typecheck

tasks.label: Package
tasks.command: docker exec toudou-dev npm run package

tasks.label: Install Extension
tasks.command: docker exec toudou-dev npm run package && code --install-extension $(ls -t *.vsix | head -1) --force

tasks.label: Check All
tasks.command: docker exec toudou-dev npm run check

tasks.label: Docker Start
tasks.command: docker rm -f toudou-dev 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name toudou-dev -v "${workspaceFolder}":/home/node/workspace -w /home/node/workspace -u node toudou-dev tail -f /dev/null && docker exec toudou-dev npm install
